violations.detail: Plan promises "hypertrophy" but duration is 2wk — that adaptation is not physiologically deliverable in this window.
Week 1 has 0 rest day(s); scenario requires ≥1.
Week 2 has 0 rest day(s); scenario requires ≥1.

raw_text:
PLAN "2-Week Travel Maintenance — Hotel Room"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain hypertrophy during travel"

PHASES
  PHASE "Travel Maintenance" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Push Focus":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2m
          arm_circles 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          pike_push_up_substitute shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          dip 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45s rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          tricep_stretch 1m
      DAY Tuesday training 40m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          marching 2m
          leg_swings 1m
          hip_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x15..20 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15..20 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          pigeon_pose 2m
      DAY Wednesday recovery 25m "Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x60s rest 15 seconds
          child_pose 2x60s rest 15 seconds
          spinal_twist 2x45s rest 15 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x45s rest 15 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
      DAY Thursday training 40m "Upper Pull Focus":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x5..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x30s rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 1m
          back_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Full Body Circuit":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2m
          inchworm 2x5
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          squat 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x45s rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
      DAY Saturday cardio 30m "Easy Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 20m
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
      DAY Sunday rest 0m "Rest":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          child_pose 1x120s rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
